Warm tungsten diorama against charcoal UI, brass accents, film grain.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Same escape-room designer game after a failed session. A large bezel-framed CCTV monitor fills the left, playing back the isometric detective-study room in green night vision with scanlines; the three guest figures are clustered in front of the safe, one sitting on the floor, their scribbled looping trails around it, and a blazing orange-white heatmap bloom over the safe. A red callout reads '19분 정체', a yellow dashed circle pulses around the ignored grandfather clock with a note '벽시계 · 아무도 안 봄'. A playback scrubber below has a long red stalled segment. Beneath, a dark chart of stepped progress lines for three teams over sixty minutes, two green and gold lines reaching the exit, one red line flat at the safe. Right column: cream paper review cards in serif type with star ratings, one stamped with a rotated red '환불' rubber stamp; a tally panel with '−₩66,000' in red, a dashed blue design-fix suggestion, and a brass button '수정하고 다시 시뮬'. Top bar: label tape '방탈출 제작자' and red tape '시간 초과 · 탈출 실패'. Moody charcoal, phosphor green, heat orange, cream paper; grain and vignette. Correction: the tally panel shows exactly '입장료 3팀 × ₩22,000 = ₩66,000', '환불 1팀 −₩22,000' (red) and '최종 수익 ₩44,000' — the arithmetic must agree. No calendar dates or years anywhere (CCTV timestamp shows only '세션 #12 · 60:00', review cards show no dates).
